responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation URL mapping for the bare-metal Nios II ELF-specific target options declared in elf.opt. This companion metadata file associates switches such as -msmallc, -msys-lib=, -msys-crt0=, and -mhal with anchors in the GCC manual so the generated option tables and diagnostics/help infrastructure can reference the correct Nios II option documentation without affecting code generation or subtarget policy itself.
